title: Falls Short
text:
Falls Short. I selected this blanket as a solution to an issue we have had regarding "differences of opinion" regarding the proper temperature setting on the thermostat. I selected it with the hope that it would be lightweight and still warm enough to take off the chill when the temperature is low at night. It does help but it is not the full solution to the issue at hand.

First off, this looks like a thermal blanket but it does not work as well as a true thermal blanket. The weave is nice and it has a nice waffle pattern in the fabric, but it does not retain the heat as we hoped. A fleece throw (even a fake one made of synthetic material) works better at retaining heat.

To be fair, this is a decent blanket and it does work as an added layer when trying to get warm at night. As a single layer thought it leaves much to be desired.

There has been some discussion about if it shrinks when it is washed and dried. So far we have not laundered this blanket so I do not know yet if it will shrink. I received the king size for use on a queen or twin bed so shrinkage will not be an issue in my case, but that is only because I am using it on a smaller bed.

This is a decent blanket in it's own right, but it is mis-marketed as a thermal blanket when it doesn't retain heat like a thermal blanket should. It's a good solution if adding layers, but as a stand-alone blanket it falls short.
